"Fractal Aircraft" > Hmmmmm

NASA announces the X-70 Fractal Experimental Aircraft, a crewed vehicle that will be "rapidly reconfigurable" to enable NASA to test aircraft maneuverability in ways never before demonstrated.  

The aircraft can also accommodate up to 2,000 pounds of experimental payloads in internal and external locations ....  Sorry no pictures available.  🛫
